description: Pakistan Aviation Statistics is a dataset listed in Open Data Pakistan portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gallup Pakistan. This dataset provides detailed statistics on passenger, cargo, and aircraft traffic flows across airports and airlines in Pakistan. It includes annual volumes, domestic and international route data, and trends in air transport activity. The information supports analysis related to travel demand, infrastructure planning, and performance monitoring within the aviation sector. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher Gallup Pakistan. Its tags are PCAA, airline, airport, aviation, cargo. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-pk-od-portal.
